## About
Los Angeles Electrical Services is based on Amboy Ave in Sun Valley and does residential, commercial and industrial electrical work across Los Angeles County and Orange County. That covers panel upgrades, rewiring old wiring, lighting, troubleshooting, correcting violations and a lot more.
We are licensed, insured and bonded, and we offer free job estimates and a lifetime guarantee on all our services. The highest compliment our clients can give us is referring their friends, family and business associates.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 20 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Mel by name and use words like thorough and patient. We are open every day of the week, morning to evening.

## Services
- Meter and panel upgrades: Installation, repair and servicing of meters and electrical panels.
- Conversion from fuses to breakers: Swapping out an old fuse box for breakers.
- Rewiring and repairing old wiring: Fixing or replacing outdated wiring in older buildings.
- Lighting design and programmable lighting: All types of lighting design, plus programmable lighting systems.
- Switches, receptacles, fans and smoke detectors: Installation and repair of switches, GFCI protected receptacles, ceiling and exhaust fans, and smoke detectors.
- Pool and hot tub wiring: Wiring for pools and hot tubs.
- Electrical violations removed: Taking care of electrical violations on your property.
- Home safety inspection: A look over your home's electrical system to spot problems.
- Factory and restaurant wiring: Wiring repair and installation for factories and restaurants.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. Job estimates are free, and all our services come with a lifetime guarantee.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve all of Los Angeles County and Orange County from our shop in Sun Valley.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Los Angeles Electrical Services is licensed, insured and bonded.
